youtube_description:
In the early winter of 2019, students attending a projects course from Northern Kentucky University were tasked with attending PAX Unplugged 2019 in Philadelphia, one of the largest analog and board gaming conventions in the United States. The goal was to film segments for a news documentary in collaboration with NKU's Norse Media. In honor of the one year anniversary of this project, and with the video game "Cyberpunk 2077" releasing soon, here is an edited version of an interview with Table Top Role-Playing Game company, R. Talsorian. This company is best known for the original "Cyberpunk" TTRPG and "The Witcher" TTRPG. A small team and I were fortunate enough to interview Cody Pondsmith, the General Manager of the company and son of R. Talsorian's founder, Mike Pondsmith.

Special thanks to R. Talsorian and Cody Pondsmith for taking the time during PAX Unplugged 2019 to speak with us.
